fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges to maintain a clear path for emergency vehicles approaching the main residence.
• Cut back dense plantings near the detached structure so responders can move around it without obstruction.
• Mark all access points in the perimeter fencing with reflective signage so responders can locate them quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Keep gates at all perimeter access points unlocked or equipped with a lockbox so responders are not delayed at entry points.
• Clear the vehicle parking area of parked vehicles during emergencies to give responders room to stage equipment near the main residence.
• Designate and mark a turnaround area within the front driveway or open lawn area large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse direction without backing out to the street.
• Remove or cut back vegetation growing directly against the walls of the detached structure to allow responders to work safely along its exterior.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to reduce the amount of burnable material close to the building.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees near the structure to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Remove shrubs and other vegetation growing directly against or touching the structure.
• Keep mixed vegetation near the structure cut back so there is open ground between plants and the building.
• Clear any dead or dry plant material from the base of trees and shrubs closest to the structure.
• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along both sides.
• Remove any debris or vegetation that narrows or blocks the driveway entry or turnaround area.
• Maintain the open terrain areas around the structure free of new vegetation growth or accumulated debris.
